cupertino.notes: ROUND 84 (lane y, batch 6, docs/ui/looks/cupertino-complete-y.md): raised to ready by the coordinator's standard for generic rows. System blue link, underline only on hover and press, state wash, focus ring. Viewed light and dark, 1x and 1.5x, all four cells.

cupertino.notes: ROUND 84 (lane y, batch 6, docs/ui/looks/cupertino-complete-y.md): raised to ready by the coordinator's standard. Apple separators are hairlines by design (opaque separator C6C6C8 light, 38383A dark): they are decorative and carry no state, so WCAG 1.4.11 asks no 3:1 of them (about 1.1 to 1.5:1 here). All seven cells (full width, inset 56, middle inset 16, labelled, label leading, strong, vertical) are drawn and the labels ('Or') are secondary label colour at 5:1 and better. Viewed light and dark, 1x and 1.5x.
gaps: The hairline is 1.1 to 1.5:1 by design; the Vertical cell is faint
